purpose: Lock the round gameplay minimap versus rectangular/full-screen sea chart and unify existing-world target actions without creating a second navigation authority.

locks.gameplay_minimap: round/circular, upper-right, north-up with explicit player heading
locks.full_sea_chart: rectangular/full-screen planning surface with more room for precise world context
locks.world_truth: actions may only resolve nodes/targets that actually exist in the current world
locks.movement: Tap-to-Sail mobile and Click-to-Sail desktop remain authoritative; set_navigation_world_target only receives resolved existing targets
locks.selection: combat target selection remains TargetingSystem authority; quest tracking remains TrackedQuestRuntime authority
locks.parity: same world, targets, POIs and navigation authority on mobile/web/desktop; only responsive UI dimensions differ
locks.hud: no persistent bottom map-selection bar; primary attack remains lower-right

tracked_objective: ANSTEUERN only when resolve_target returns an existing world node
